up3:1.1: Those (gods) who are peaceful, with peaceful minds, who have taken refuge in the triple refuge, whether here, or above the worlds,
up3:1.2: the various earth gods, that group who have taken up, and are engaged in, virtuous deeds all of the time,
up3:1.3: may these gods come, those who dwell on the majestic Mt. Meru, that excellent golden mountain,
up3:1.4: peacefully, and with good reason, ( to hear) the Sage’s excellent word about entering the stream, and harmony.
up3:2.1: May all yakkhas, gods, and deities, from the whole universe,
up3:2.2: ° after partaking of the merits, and of all the thoroughly good fortune
up3:2.3: we have acquired, being in harmony, and delighting in the teaching,
up3:2.4: be not heedless and grant us complete protection.
up3:3.1: May the teaching and the world be on the increase every day,
up3:3.2: And may the gods every day protect the teaching and the world.
up3:4.1: ° May you, and all those who are around you, together with
up3:4.2: all your relatives, be untroubled, happy, and easy in mind.
up3:5.1: (may you be protected) from the king, thieves, humans, and non-humans,
up3:5.2: from fire and water, demons, stumps, and thorns,
up3:5.4: from what is not the true dhamma, not right view, not a good person,
up3:5.5: and from fierce elephants, horses, antelopes, bulls, dogs, snakes, scorpions, poisonous serpents,
up3:5.6: panthers, bears, hyenas, wild boars, buffaloes, yakkhas, rakkhasas, and so on,
up3:5.7: from the manifold fears, the manifold diseases,
up3:5.8: the manifold calamities, (from all of these troubles) may you receive protection!
up3:6.1: Beginning with the aspiration (for Buddhahood, and thinking of) the Realised One’s ten perfections,
up3:6.2: ten minor perfections, ten great perfections - altogether thirty perfections,
up3:6.3: his five great sacrifices, three ways of conduct,
up3:6.4: descent into the womb for his final existence, birth,
up3:6.5: Great Renunciation, life of effort, sitting cross legged at the Bodhi tree, victory over Māra,
up3:6.6: his penetration and knowledge of omniscience, and his nine supermundane attainments,
up3:6.7: and after considering all these Buddha qualities, (going around) the three walls of Vesāli,
up3:6.8: during the three watches of the night, the venerable elder Ānanda,
up3:6.9: after establishing great compassion in his heart, made this safeguard.
